title: Think start and stop, not mount and unmount

slides.say: Thinking of Effects as callbacks like after mount or before unmount gets complicated fast.
From the Effect’s point of view, there is just one story: connected to a room, until disconnected.

slides.text: general (until stop) → travel (until stop) → music (until stop). Non-overlapping periods.
slides.say: Over time that is just a series of non overlapping periods: general, then travel, then music. Each one starts and stops.

slides.text: Describe how to start and how to stop. React handles when.
slides.say: So focus on one start and stop cycle. Describe how to start and stop, and your Effect works no matter how often React runs it.
